Veriler üzerinde yapay zeka teknikleri kullanılarak gizli ilişkilerin keşfedilmesi ve analiz edilmesi sürecidir.
Verilerin kategorilere veya gruplara ayrıldığı türüdür. Örneğin, 'erkek' veya 'kadın' gibi değerler bu türdür.
Verilerin ölçümlerden oluştuğu türüdür. Örneğin, öğrencilerin İngilizce notları gibi sayısal değerler bu türdür.
Veri analize hazır hale getirme sürecidir. Eksik veya yanlış verileri düzeltmek ve veriyi düzenlemek için yapılır.
Oluşturulan veriyi analiz eden modelin ne kadar doğru olduğunu test etme ve doğrulama sürecidir.
Veri bilimi alanında en çok kullanılan, açık kaynaklı, ücretsiz ve kolay öğrenilebilir bir programlama dilidir.
Bir programlama dilinin içinde bulunan, belirli işlevleri kolaylaştıran ve projelerde kullanılabilecek özel yazılımlardır.
Veri bilimi için kullanılan, Python kütüphanelerini ve kod yazma araçlarını (editörleri) tek bir platformda barındıran bir yazılımdır.
Veri bilimi için kullanılan, hem kod yazıp çalıştırabileceğiniz hem de metin ve grafik ekleyebileceğiniz web tabanlı bir araçtır.
A popular way of organizing work teams that helps them work together closely to finish tasks quickly and solve problems.
A list where the team writes down all the ideas and tasks they want to do, and they decide which ones to do first.
A short period of time, usually two weeks, where the team works together to finish a specific part of the project.
A short meeting every day where the team checks how much work they have done and sees if anything is stopping them.
A person who helps the team follow the rules of the project, shares information with everyone, and makes sure the team does its best work.
The person who decides what is most important to do, owns the list of all the work, and makes sure the final result is very useful.
A simple way to show how work is going by using a board with pictures that show if a task is not started, being worked on, or finished.
A rule that says the team can only have a certain number of tasks they are working on at the same time so they do not get too busy.
The goal of making work move quickly and smoothly so that tasks are finished faster when the team focuses on fewer things.
A method that takes normal software development steps and does them very carefully, such as testing small parts of the work before building the whole thing.
When two people work together at the same time on one task to help them understand the work and find mistakes quickly.
A practice where the team adds new changes to the project many times a day to check if everything still works correctly.
A rule that says you should not plan every detail of the project at the very beginning, but instead start simple and improve the plan as you go.
A way of planning where the tests for the project tell the team what to build and also show if what they built is correct.

This is a type of artificial intelligence that can create new original content, such as writing stories, making images, or generating music, instead of just finding or sorting existing information.

These are computer systems that work like the human brain. They are made of many connected numbers or parts that learn from data to make predictions and understand complex topics.
This is a method used to teach the AI by checking if its guesses were wrong and then adjusting its internal settings to get better at predicting the next word.
This is a training process where humans test the AI's answers and give feedback to teach it what is good and what is bad, helping it avoid doing harmful things.

This refers to the first stage of training where the AI learns from a huge amount of text on the internet. It is called 'pre-trained' because it is ready to use before you start giving it specific tasks.
This is a smart tool that can handle many different types of information at once, such as understanding text, seeing images, and listening to audio, all in one place.
These are special rules or connections that allow a computer program to talk directly to an AI model to get answers or perform tasks automatically.
These are AI tools that can work on their own without you having to ask them for help every time. They can use other tools, like the internet or a phone, to get things done.
